data.name: Zombonk
data.detailed_description:
One idiot vs. ten thousand zombies

Zombonk is a comedic survivors-like about one thing: scale. The horde isn't a wave — it's a flood of thousands of zombies pouring through a real city street grid. You're the only thing standing in its way.

The run

Pure survivors-like at heart: your weapons fire themselves — you steer, hoover up pick-ups, pick one of three on every level-up, and chase the god-run until the tide finally gets you. Fast, dumb-simple, dopamine-forward.

The city is your weapon

  • Herd the flood down an avenue into your wall of mines
  • Blow the gas main when the street packs shoulder-to-shoulder
  • Hold the chokepoint until it cracks — then run

Extract or lose it

No main menu — you live in a bunker under the city. Surface through a manhole, farm the streets, and get back underground with your haul; get overwhelmed and you keep only part of it. What you bring home feeds the bunker you're building toward escape.

data.short_description: A comedic survivors-like where you're the last thing standing between a city and a flood of thousand zombies. Auto-blast your way through the streets, herd the horde into minefields and chokepoints, level up, extract to your bunker — then go again.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with 2 GB VRAM (GTX 750 Ti / RX 550 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or SteamOS 3
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with 2 GB VRAM, Vulkan support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
